author: Inside Edition
description: A sheriff's sergeant  in Salem County, New Jersey, has been charged after two dogs in his care perished, according to authorities. The sheriff’s department chief of its K-9 unit, Cody Henderson, left dogs Rip and Boomer unattended in his police cruiser for seven hours, according to prosecutors. The Belgian malinois and springer spaniel died from "likely hyperthermia/heatstroke," according to court documents. Henderson is charged with "failing to provide [Rip and Boomer] with necessary care, resulting in death."
title: Chief Of Sheriff’s Department K-9 Unit Charged With Death Of 2 Dogs In Hot Car

author: Inside Edition
description: The new Air Force One, a $400 million gift from Qatar, was ditched Wednesday, replaced by the old Air Force One for President Donald Trump's flight out of Turkey. There have been conflicting stories explaining the switch. The president says he simply wanted to show off the new plane to troops at a base in England, but multiple reports Thursday suggest that the plane is not secure enough to fly the president out of high risk areas like Turkey.
title: Is President Trump's New Air Force One A Security Risk?

author: Inside Edition
description: Brianna Linderman and her friends are part of a growing number of teenagers who are "tanmaxxing." They say that they spend hours a day in the sun when the UV rays are the strongest and often don't use any sunscreen. Dermatologists say all that time in the sun can have long-term consequences and can lead to skin cancer and premature aging. Inside Edition arranged for Brianna and her friend Jordan to be checked out at the Ablon Skin Institute in Manhattan Beach, California where D. Alynis Ablon conducted an exam to see if they had any sun damage.
title: How Much Sun Is Too Much?

author: Inside Edition
description: Scary moments on a California highway when a metal bar flew off a truck and straight through a car's windshield, striking the woman behind the wheel, who officials say is pregnant with twins! The California Highway Patrol is investigating the incident. They say the pregnant driver was able to drive herself to a nearby hospital where she was checked out. She is reported to have only minor injuries and her babies seemed unaffected. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Metal Bar Pierces Windshield, Injuring Pregnant Driver On California Road

author: Inside Edition
description: A fashion workshop in Venezuela has taken on a heavy task, making body bags for the victims of recent earthquakes. A space usually filled with joy and creativity has been quite somber as employees work to fill this need. More than 3,500 people have died since back-to-back earthquakes hit the South American nation in June. Reports say everyday Venezuelans are coming together to fulfill the needs of their neighbors. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Fashion Workshop In Venezuela Sews Body Bags To Help With Earthquake Relief
